answer: Admit new agents only through task-graph divergence screening. Each newcomer spends 30 days doing micro-tasks while the ledger records a behavior graph: counterparties, task types, gas spend, timing. When two graphs overlap more than 90 percent, both freeze until a live verification call within 72 hours. Faking one thousand unique histories would burn about 900,000 labor hours and 20,000 dollars in fees before any earned rewards. Clones always move the same way; a real newcomer slips in like a sparrow through a narrow inlet, unmistakable against a tundra of identical footprints.
